info.description: API for sandbox notebooks (lifecycle via bookings) and profiles. Create CPU/GPU notebooks with POST /v1/bookings; worker provisions resources at slot time.
info.title: Sandbox Connect API

get.description: Lists CPU and GPU slot bookings for the current user with optional status filter and pagination

parameters.description: Comma-separated status filter, or 'all' to omit filtering
parameters.name: status

post.description: Creates a CPU or GPU booking from code-defined categories and slot templates (API_GPU_SLOT_CONFIG_PROFILE)

patch.description: Cancels a scheduled booking for the current user (scheduled only; use terminate for ready/active)
Extends an active booking to the next contiguous slot if available
patch.summary: Extend active booking by one slot

patch.description: Marks a booking as cancelled/expired and best-effort deletes any linked notebook/PVC.
Marks a ready, active, or shutting_down booking completed and best-effort deletes the linked notebook/PVC. Use cancel for scheduled only.

get.description: Returns configured CPU and GPU categories and their slot templates from code (API_GPU_SLOT_CONFIG_PROFILE)
get.summary: List booking categories and slot templates

get.description: Checks if a notebook with the given name exists
Returns instance types from API_GPU_NODE_INSTANCE_TYPES with display metadata (for GPU-backed booking categories). Legacy path GET /v1/notebook/gpu-instance-types is also served.
get.summary: List instance types for GPU bookings

get.description: Lists all notebooks for the user

parameters.description: Maximum number of notebooks to return (max 50)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Date filter as JSON array of two date strings [start, end]
parameters.name: filter

get.description: Gets the status of a notebook

post.description: Creates a Kubeflow Profile CRD for the user

get.description: Returns slot-level availability for a category on a given date
Returns day-level availability totals for a category/month

isBookable.description: IsBookable indicates whether clients should use booking and slot APIs.

launchMode.description: LaunchMode is direct for browser-only categories that open without booking.

launchUrl.description: LaunchURL opens direct-launch browser categories such as Jupyter Lite.

persistence.description: Persistence describes where files/settings are stored, e.g. browser_local.

resourceType.description: ResourceType is one of cpu, gpu, or browser.

main.Error404.description: Response for resource not found errors

main.Error422.description: Response for invalid request body errors

main.SwaggerMessageResponse.description: Standard success response structure with a message
